title: The Maharashtra Metropolitan Planning Committees (Constitution and Functions) (Continuance of Provisions) Act, 1999
full_text: The Maharashtra Metropolitan Planning Committees (Constitution and Functions) (Continuance of Provisions) Act, 1999 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20005 Act Number: 5 Enactment Date: 2000-01-07 Act Year: 2000 Short Title: The Maharashtra Metropolitan Planning Committees (Constitution and Functions) (Continuance of Provisions) Act, 1999 Long Title: An Act to provide for constituting in every Metropolitan area a Metropolitan Planning Committee to prepare a draft development plan for the Metropolitan area as a wholeand to provide for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
